theorems.name: Submission.chartTD_biLipschitz_chart_approx_tangent
theorems.statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (B : Set (Rn n)) (ψ : Rn n → Rn N) (K : ℝ≥0) (c : ℝ), IsOpen B → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 ψ B → LipschitzOnWith K ψ B → 0 < c → (∀ u ∈ B, ∀ u' ∈ B, c * ‖u - u'‖ ≤ ‖ψ u - ψ u'‖) → ∀ u ∈ B, HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n (ψ '' B) (ψ u) (LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ ψ u).toLinearMap)
